headword: {青春時代|せいしゅんじだい}

definitions.gloss: one's youth; adolescent years; the springtime of life
definitions.explanation: The years of late adolescence and early adulthood, roughly the school and university period, seen as a time of energy, friendship, and first love. The word is warm and nostalgic, and is almost always used looking back.

examples.japanese: {青春時代|せいしゅんじだい}を{思|おも}い{出|だ}す。
{父|ちち}の{青春時代|せいしゅんじだい}の{写真|しゃしん}を{見|み}せてもらった。
examples.english: I was shown photographs from my father's youth.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}{練習|れんしゅう}ばかりだったが、あの{三年間|さんねんかん}が{私|わたし}の{青春時代|せいしゅんじだい}だった。
examples.english: It was nothing but practice every day, but those three years were the springtime of my life.

notes:
{青春|せいしゅん} (youth, literally "blue spring") + {時代|じだい} (era, period). The word carries the emotional colour of {青春|せいしゅん} — idealism, intensity, and things that cannot come again.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {青春時代|せいしゅんじだい}を{過|す}ごす: to spend one's youth
- {青春時代|せいしゅんじだい}の{思|おも}い{出|で}: memories of one's youth
- {青春時代|せいしゅんじだい}に{戻|もど}りたい: to want to go back to one's youth

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {若|わか}いころ: when one was young — plain and factual, without the nostalgic warmth
- {少年時代|しょうねんじだい}: boyhood — earlier, roughly the elementary and junior high years
- {思春期|ししゅんき}: puberty, adolescence — a clinical term for the developmental stage
